case.question: Assess a Zebra Android web app: Chrome or Enterprise Browser for seven device-integration requirements.

reportedContext.deviceModel: TC22, TC201, TC501 as written; identifiers and compatibility not verified
reportedContext.developmentEnvironment: Standard Android Chrome preferred; Enterprise Browser considered
reportedContext.integrationNeeds: Scan data and symbology without focus; on-screen scan controls; physical keys; file access; navigation controls; configuration transfer; OCR/barcode switching
reportedContext.operatingConstraint: Normal device operation should not require an external PC or Windows application
reportedContext.sourceProvenance: User supplied complete rendered public-thread export on 2026-10-26. Original post and three historical replies are preserved separately; replies are not model results or validated solutions.
reportedContext.resolutionStatus: No independent device test, customer acceptance or verified final resolution

sourceReview.title: Scan control is conditional on the active DataWedge profile
sourceReview.finding: DataWedge documents software scan start, stop and toggle commands with Barcode Input enabled in the active profile. A documented native command does not by itself establish how JavaScript in Chrome sends that command.
sourceReview.condition: No device, Android or installed DataWedge version is fixed in the question. This is one source for one sub-requirement, not coverage of all seven.
sourceReview.nextCheck: For on-screen scanning, verify the browser-to-native integration and profile prerequisites separately. Retain the other six requirements as unresolved review work.
sourceReview.notEstablished: No new model answer, browser/device runtime, measured maintainer time saving or accepted solution is established.
